productionBaseline.interpretation: Failures collapse to maintenance rewrite loop and non-refetching retry controls. Genuine server errors produce500 and hide injected private messages. Root-layout metadata is intentionally absent in the first minimal harness, so its segment-error document-title violation is a harness limitation; global-error missing title is a product finding because it replaces root metadata.

requiredProductFixes.observed: In production Next start, MAINTENANCE_MODE=true causes /, /calculators, /api/qa, /missing-route and /maintenance to exceed6-second timeout. Health/public asset bypass works. Both localhost and127.0.0.1 reproduced.
requiredProductFixes.candidate: Inside maintenance mode, handle /maintenance with NextResponse.next({status:503,headers}) instead of rewriting it to itself. Other pages may continue rewriting to /maintenance. Preserve Retry-After300, Cache-Control no-store and X-Robots-Tag noindex.
requiredProductFixes.verified: Controlled variants: removing503 still hangs; direct503 responds; target pass-through responds503 with intended HTML and headers. Full candidate20/20 passed.

requiredProductFixes.observed: Clear injected server fault, then select Try again: existing reset callback leaves the cached failed server payload on screen at both widths.
requiredProductFixes.candidate: Use the current Next16.4 retry prop/handler. Unlike reset, retry fetches server content again.
requiredProductFixes.verified: Both segment and root fault recovery passed at both widths with retry.

requiredProductFixes.observed: Global error replaces the root layout and has no document title; axe reports document-title.
requiredProductFixes.candidate: Render an explicit React title in the replacement document; optional explicit noindex meta also survives replaced root metadata.
requiredProductFixes.verified: Candidate <title>Page error | Finflo</title> resolves axe document-title at both widths.

productionCandidate.changes: Only /tmp copies use retry, a global title/noindex meta, and a maintenance-target pass-through. Root product integration/retest remains required.

additionalObservations.fact: Direct /maintenance is200/noindex when maintenance mode is off; active maintenance proxy returns503.
additionalObservations.interpretation: Informational route behavior, not a failure.

additionalObservations.fact: Any pathname containing a dot bypasses current maintenance condition; unknown /some.page returns404.
additionalObservations.interpretation: Broader than a static-asset allowlist; low-impact observation for current known routes, not counted as a failed requirement.
